caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large “How to Craft Your POV” promise places “POV” in a compact lavender tag.
visual_anatomy.layout: A centered five-layer cylindrical stack is flanked by a left explanation column and a right mistakes-to-avoid column.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title / clarifier → central bottom-to-top progression → horizontally aligned explanation and failure-mode boxes.
visual_anatomy.typography: Plain oversized title, rough highlighted acronym, bold stage labels on the cylinders, and compact explanatory sans text in flanking boxes.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pastel lavender, pink, aqua, blue, and peach distinguish stack layers and corresponding note boxes.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, thin dark outlines, softly shaded cylinders, rounded note boxes, and a bottom directional arrow.
visual_anatomy.modules: Five sequential layers plus five explanatory and five caution modules paired by color/height.
visual_anatomy.density: High: progression and counterexamples coexist because their positions are synchronized.

motion.observed_state_change: The centered stack starts flattened, rises into distinct cylinders, and brings its stage labels into readable position while side notes retain their anchors.
motion.motion_job: Make an ordered layered metaphor physically assemble, revealing the dependencies between steps.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand a dependency-ordered sequence while seeing common failure modes at the corresponding stage.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Put the main progression in one physical object and align explanatory / exception material to the relevant level.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only where the order and dependency are true; a stack should not be used to decorate an unordered list.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the POV framework, layered-cylinder object, side-note pairing, color sequence, title tag, or animation choreography.

claim_boundary.note: The asset is a conceptual framework; matching caption metadata is asserted by numeric ID rather than verified provenance.
